keywords: how to increase iPhone volume, iPhone volume too low, make iPhone louder, iPhone speaker quiet, increase volume on iPhone, iPhone louder than max
title: How to Increase iPhone Volume: 8 Fixes When It's Too Quiet
description: iPhone too quiet even at full volume? Check the settings that cap sound, clean the speaker, fix Bluetooth, then make quiet videos and audio up to 10× louder.
h1: How to increase iPhone volume when it's too quiet
card_summary: Settings that silently cap volume, speaker and Bluetooth checks, and what to do when the phone is already at max.
quick_answer: To increase iPhone volume, first turn off Reduce Loud Audio in Settings › Sounds & Haptics › Headphone Safety, try EQ «Late Night» in Settings › Music, check Balance, clean the speaker grille and make sure sound isn't going to Bluetooth. The system can't play louder than 100%: if one video or recording is still quiet at max, make the file itself louder with Increase Volume (up to ×10) and save a new copy.
intro: Your iPhone is at maximum and you still can't hear the video, the voice message or the song. Usually one of a few settings is quietly capping the volume, or the sound is going somewhere else.
Work through the fixes below in order. If everything is set correctly and one particular file is still quiet, the problem is the recording itself — and that can be fixed too.

screenshot.caption: iOS can't go above 100%, but a quiet file can be made up to 10× louder.

sections.heading: Settings that cap iPhone volume (check these first)
paragraphs: These settings don't show a warning, they just keep the sound lower than it could be:
list: Reduce Loud Audio: Settings → Sounds & Haptics → Headphone Safety. When on, it caps headphone output at the level you set. Turn it off or raise the limit.
Sound Check: Settings → Music → Sound Check levels all tracks to the same loudness, which pulls loud songs down. Turn it off if everything feels soft.
EQ: Settings → Music → EQ. Late Night compresses dynamics so quiet parts come up; Loudness lifts bass and treble at low volume. Try both.
Volume Limit / Screen Time: Settings → Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions → Volume Limit can be locked by a parent or an old setting.
Bluetooth: some earbuds and speakers keep their own volume level; raise it on the device too.

sections.heading: Speaker, case and Bluetooth
paragraphs: Lint in the bottom speaker grille or a case covering it can cut the volume noticeably — brush it gently with a soft, dry brush. Open Control Center and check the audio output: if AirPods or a Bluetooth speaker are still connected, the sound plays there. If calls sound quiet, hold the phone so the earpiece at the top is against your ear.

sections.heading: At maximum and still too quiet? Make the file louder
paragraphs: The volume buttons only change how loud the phone plays. If a video, voice memo or MP3 was recorded quietly, it stays quiet on every device. Increase Volume raises the level inside the file up to ×10 and saves a new copy, so it plays louder everywhere — including on other people's phones.

steps.heading: Step by step: make a quiet file louder
steps.intro: About a minute, using the free app from the App Store.

items.name: Open the file
items.text: Share a video from Photos or an audio file from Files to Increase Volume.

items.name: Choose the boost
items.text: Drag «Volume multiplication»: ×2–×4 for music, ×3–×6 for speech, up to ×10 for very quiet recordings.

items.name: Compare
items.text: Tap «Boost Volume» and switch between Original and Processed to check for distortion.

items.name: Save
items.text: Tap «Download Processed» and save the louder copy to Photos or Files.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Restart the iPhone if the sound suddenly dropped everywhere: a stuck audio route is a common cause.
Check the Ringer and Alerts slider separately — it does not change media volume.
Boost a file before sharing it: platforms and other phones can't fix a quiet recording.

faq.question: Can I make iPhone louder than the maximum volume?
faq.answer: Not for the whole system — 100% is the hardware limit. You can make individual videos and audio files louder with an app like Increase Volume.

faq.question: Why did my iPhone volume get lower by itself?
faq.answer: Usually Headphone Safety lowered it after loud listening, Sound Check is on, or the output switched to Bluetooth.

faq.question: Does cleaning the speaker really help?
faq.answer: Yes, if the grille is clogged. Use a soft dry brush; never push sharp objects or liquids into it.
